children: Threshold Network is ending RebateStaking and replacing it with a peg-keeper allowlist managed by the Council. The tBTC fee rebates that T stakers receive through the program will stop no earlier than 00:00 UTC on December 24, 2026.
Once the rebates stop, T stakers can withdraw their staked tokens immediately. They do not have to wait 30 days or pay a penalty to withdraw.
📣 TIP-111 has passed the DAO vote!
The Threshold DAO voted 99.1% in favor of replacing RebateStaking with a Threshold Council-governed peg-keeper allowlist.

title: Threshold Network: RebateStaking ends - By 24 Dec 2026
